# HW Media

> HW Media is a director-led film production company in London, founded by director and cinematographer Harry Wallis. We make brand films, commercials, documentary and photography for brands including McLaren, Nike, Aston Martin, Ferrari, Land Rover (Defender), Salomon, Zuma and Castle Air. Every film is directed and shot by Harry Wallis; edit, grade and aerials (CAA-authorised drone work) stay in-house.

Key facts:
- Based in London, United Kingdom; shoots across the UK and internationally — wherever the story is.
- Director-led: the person who promises the film is the person behind the camera.
- Services: brand films, commercial video production, documentary, live events, aerial cinematography, photography, edit & grade, social cutdowns.
- Typical project runs two to six weeks from brief to final master; full campaigns have turned around in under 72 hours.
- Deliverables include the master film plus vertical, square and short-form cutdowns mastered for every channel.
- Every project gets a clear fixed quote before anything is booked.
- Contact: harry@hwmedia.co.uk
